description: Use first for a question about whether a paper reproduces or replicates; this looks up an existing computational re-run, not a new experiment. Look up one paper in the OpenRepro ledger and return its re-run outcome with its qualifiers (such as a broad bound or a check that missed), how many agent-designated controls were excluded and how many gates the test had (when it has any), how many headline claims held, the assurance level, and links to the report and evidence. Matches arXiv IDs, DOIs, URLs, titles, short names and aliases. Ask about ANY arXiv paper. With no exact match it returns close matches when there are any. With neither, a whole arXiv ID, arXiv: prefixed id, or https://arxiv.org/abs/ or /pdf/ URL returns code_facts (NOT a reproduction) and the optional rerun request. This fetches public metadata for that id from arXiv, Hugging Face and GitHub; no caller information is forwarded. The code link's origin is stated and unverified.

paper.description: arXiv ID (1607.01759), DOI (10.1126/science.abb9789), an arXiv/doi.org/openrepro.org URL, the paper's title, or a name it is known by (fastText, PINNs, the Leiden algorithm)

name: check_paper
title: Check whether a paper reproduced
